title: GPSA GIMIS Procuring Entity Registration Form
description: Registration form for procuring entities (MDA) to enroll in the GPSA Integrated Management Information System (GIMIS). Government institutions must complete and submit this form for GIMIS access.

contact.name: Government Procurement Services Agency
contact.address: Mtaa wa Bohari, Barabara ya Nyerere, P.O. Box 9150, Dar es Salaam

eligibility: Public procuring entities (ministries, departments, agencies, councils, institutions) seeking GIMIS registration
